old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-zhuq","title":"[review] OSCORE ctx-miss sends 4.01 then handler falls through to second 4.00 ACK (double response, same MID)","description":"P1, confirmed independently by 2 reviewers. coap_oscore_unprotect_resource_request ctx-lookup-failure path (lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/coap_oscore.c:62-65) SENDS 4.01 via coap_oscore_send_unauthorized and returns coap_err_to_oscore(...) = 0 (OSCORE_OK). Triggered by any OSCORE request with no established ctx (normal after node reboot).
